text: General Veeran put all his gold on one ship. One storm, and ninety nine percent was gone.
Welcome back to the King's Treasury. Last time, Prince Arun's seeds grew a forest. Today, the king's three friends arrive.
Minister Mathi, with his palm leaf scroll. Merchant Selvan, from the sweet shop. And brave General Veeran, with a hot tip.
The fastest ship in the harbour, he said. I'll load all one thousand gold on it, and come back rich.
Prince Vel cheered. The king turned to Minister Mathi. Mathi smiled, and split Prince Arun's gold across ten ships. A hundred on each.
Then the storm came. Stay with me, because this part really happened in our market.
Veeran's ship sank. From a thousand gold, only fourteen came back. Arun lost one ship, but nine came home.
In August twenty eighteen, Yes Bank shares touched four hundred and four rupees. By March twenty twenty, five rupees fifty five. Down ninety nine percent.
In the same time, the Nifty fifty, fifty big companies in one basket, slipped only about six percent.
Three rules of the ships. Never load everything on one. Spread it across many. And never sail on a stranger's tip.
Save this, send it to the friend with one favourite stock, and follow money in cloud for episode four. One ship, all the gold, one storm.
